about: Words a fabric description may not use at a public kiosk (see fabric.py, PromptFilter). Each list has a message shown when a description is refused. Matching ignores case, accents, spaces and digits standing in for letters. A file of the same form named by $BIFOLD_FABRIC_WORDS adds words, lists or 'allow' entries. The words of 'offensive_rot13' are ROT13-encoded, so the repository does not show them in plain text.

brands.message: Brand names can't be made into a fabric here ({word}). Describe the colours, the pattern and the material instead, for example "beige and black check wool".

characters.message: Characters and other trademarks can't be made into a fabric here ({word}). Describe the colours, the pattern and the material instead, for example "white stars on navy cotton".

marks.message: Logos and trademarks can't be made into a fabric here ({word}). Describe the colours, the pattern and the material instead.

offensive.message: That description uses a word this kiosk does not accept. Please describe the colours, the pattern and the material of the fabric.

offensive_rot13.message: That description uses a word this kiosk does not accept. Please describe the colours, the pattern and the material of the fabric.
